result.summary: Backports two changes to the 31.x maintenance branch: storing depends local package tarballs in WORK_PATH (#35765) and dropping CMake developer warning errors (#36927). It also updates the v31.x release notes.
result.problem: When SOURCES_PATH is shared across checkouts, Guix builds can find another checkout's local package tarball and build from the wrong sources because local archives lack content hashes. Separately, treating CMake developer warnings as errors in dev-mode presets and CI can cause developer builds to break when run with newer CMake versions.
evidence: Commit df4edd63b0 notes that building from the wrong sources 'happens reliably with contrib/guix/guix-build, which shares SOURCES_PATH with its build container and mounts every checkout at /bitcoin inside it, so all checkouts use the same tarball path.'
result.scope_notes: Backport PR targeting the 31.x maintenance branch.
result.changed_since_previous: Added the backport of #35765 to store depends local source archives in WORK_PATH alongside the previously included #36927.
result.card: Backports build fixes to the 31.x maintenance branch from PRs #35765 and #36927. It stores local package tarballs in WORK_PATH instead of SOURCES_PATH in the depends system, preventing Guix builds with a shared source directory from silently building from another checkout's local tarballs. It also removes CMake -Werror=dev flags from dev-mode presets and CI scripts to prevent newer CMake releases from failing maintenance branch builds.

risk.why: Mistakes could cause build failures in depends or CMake configurations on the 31.x branch.
